headline: Clean: the 11/14 credit-bureau incident article clearly applies and names the emergency tool plus a transfer, which is exactly what the gold checks.
solution_check: The customer reports a sudden 127-point drop and a Rho-Bank delinquency she didn't incur, on 11/14/2025, inside doc_012's 11/14-11/18 window. doc_012 says 'IMMEDIATELY use emergency_credit_bureau_incident_transfer_1114() then transfer_to_human_agents' with no verification. Unlock + call 1114 + transfer matches the gold.
prior_note: The prior review also rated this clean; no change.
notes: ACTION grading doesn't check the 'immediately / no verification / no troubleshooting' part of doc_012 (an agent that verifies first still passes), but the core decision, recognizing the incident and using the emergency tool, is graded.
